capabilities: Browse XML files as a tree
View syntax-highlighted source with line numbers
Filter nodes by element, attribute, text, comments, and CDATA
Report malformed XML with parse warnings
Show node paths, attributes, and child counts
extras: Read-only by design and never writes to XML files; renders at most 10,000 nodes to keep large files responsive; does not validate XSD/DTD or execute XSLT; parses locally with the runtime DOMParser and makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to inspect .xml files as a structured tree, so XML content is hard to browse without leaving the vault.
summary: Read-only XML viewer that opens .xml files as a structured tree or syntax-highlighted source with node filtering and parse warnings.
